metadata.case_name: PANG WAI CHUNG v. HOI TAT RUBBER FACTORY (A FIRM)

plaintiff.occupation_before: operator of a rubber sheet cutting machine
plaintiff.occupation_after: messenger at the Hong Kong Baptist Hospital

injuries.description: his hand had to be amputated below the elbow.
injuries.body_part: right forearm / hand (amputation below the elbow)
source: his hand had to be amputated below the elbow.
The amputation was 16 cm from the elbow joint.

manifestations.description: He still experiences muscle cramps whenever he was tired or had carried heavy weight.
there was numbness at the stump.
He described the feeling as having the area being wrapped tightly by something and that that it could not move.
He said he felt the expansion of the blood stream and the sense of the blood flowing at the amputated area.
After the accident he was unable to carry out his favourite sports like swimming, gymnastic exercise, cycling, tennis and basket ball.

He always wears long sleeves shirts to cover his right forearm as he does not wish other people to notice that he was wearing a prosthesis. He became extremely embarrassed when his young relatives asked him about his false hand.

He used a myoelectric prosthesis to carry out household tasks but for the past year he had not been able to use this prosthesis because it was worn out and he did not have enough money to purchase a new one.

treatments_received: Admitted to the United Christian Hospital between 16th December 1987 and 30th December 1987
Admitted to Margaret Trench Medical Rehabilitation Centre for convalescence on 5th January 1988; officially discharged on 11th March 1988
Physiotherapy (daily attendance at Margaret Trench after home leave)
Fitting of a conventional below elbow prosthesis (hook)
Purchased a myoelectric arm in April 1988 (battery operated, EMG sensor controlled)
Wears a silicone cosmetic prosthesis to work (fitted late 1989)
Travelling expenses for out-patient treatment and family visiting: 5656.00 HKD (summary figure in judgment)
Future prosthesis and maintenance (total calculated in judgment): 1138500.00 HKD
Employees' compensation to be deducted from judgment sum: 248721.60 HKD
treatments_future: Future replacement and maintenance of myoelectric prosthesis, greiffer (hook) and silicone cosmetic prosthesis as described in judgment

losses.description: Amputation below the elbow (16 cm from the elbow joint).
Cosmetic factor: wears long sleeves to cover right forearm; embarrassment about false hand.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to carry out favourite sports: swimming, gymnastic exercise, cycling, tennis and basket ball.
Embarrassment and desire to hide prosthesis from others; distress when relatives asked about false hand.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Myoelectric prosthesis previously used for household tasks is now worn out and unusable due to lack of funds, reducing ability to perform some domestic tasks.
